items.title: MIT and Boston Children's Hospital model adjusts fetal scans to track fetal movement
items.summary_en: A model developed by researchers at MIT and Boston Children's Hospital adjusts imaging scans on the fly to follow fetal movement. According to the search snippet, this could reduce repeat hospital visits.
items.notes: Seen only via search snippet; URL is a listing, not the article. Medical imaging, tangential to frontier AI. Verify.
